the sea. As a result, water cannot be used for drinking and agriculture.
4. Earthquake and landslides

Over-utilization of ground water leads to decrease in water level causing earth quake and
landslides.

5. Drying of well

Excess withdrawal of ground water, result depletion of ground water level and drying up of
the well.

6. Pollution of water:

When the gr water level near agricultural land decreases, water containing fertilizers
percolate rapidly into the aquifer and pollute ground water. As a result water becomes
unsuitable for drinking.

2.a) Why the pyramid of energy always takes upright shape? 3 2 1

Ans: Pyramid of Energy
It shows the energy available at each trophic level.

The size of each trophic level represents the proportion of productivity

It is measured in Joules or Calories.

Most of the energy available to the community is in the 1* trophic level.
Only 10-20% of the energy is available to the next trophic level (~ 90% lost)

10 kcal

100 kcal
Fishes

1000 kcal
“ooplanktons
/ Phytoplanktons \ 10,000 kcal

Pyramid of energy in an aquatic ecosystem

Pyramid of energy is the only type of ecological pyramid, which is always
upright, because the energy flow in a food chain is always unidirectional.

Also, with every increasing trophic level, some energy is lost into the environment as
heat energy.

So if we represent any ecosystem food chain in terms of the energy, the value will
always decrease from producer to higher trophic levels.

Thus pyramid shape turns upright only.

b) Enlist various causes of deforestation. 7 3 a)
Ans. Causes of deforestation

(a) Development and construction works

(b) Mining operation

(c) Various raw materials demand for industry
(d) Fuel requirement for villager and tribal people
(e) Shifting cultivation

(f) Forest fire etc.
